The format of the tournament remained the same as the [[1991–92 Honduran Liga Nacional|previous season]]. [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] won the title[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesh/hondhist.html RSSSF.com–Honduras - Final Tables 1965/66-1994/95]–11 December 2009 after winning the regular season and the final round and qualified to the [[1994 CONCACAF Champions' Cup]] along with runners-up [[C.D.
